interpretation: The exact first-party Velvia 100 dye-density basis is materially more compatible with independently measured Velvia 100F target spectra than the exact Velvia 50 and Provia 100F bases.
Each spectrum supplies its own NNLS coefficients, so this is target-dependent representation evidence and cannot be used as an application-time forward transform.
The measurement rows were used by earlier AQ/P6 experiments; the model question is new, but this is not a pristine population or an independent roll/process confirmation.
next_action: Seek a source-observable mapping from recorder or scene exposure into the retained fixed dye coordinates on an independent paired population; do not infer coefficients from application targets or retune the closed CB2/CB3 renderer.
claim_ceiling: Target-dependent spectral representation compatibility between exact first-party Fujifilm dye-density curves and independently measured Velvia 100F manufactured-target spectra; not a forward film response, independent roll/process, scanner calibration, photographic appearance or product profile.
